title: Local affine-cover vanishing of cartesian higher-image sections
statement: Under the hypotheses of the cartesian higher-image construction, if an affine etale section of a stage cartesian higher image maps to zero in the limit, then there are a later stage and a finite etale affine cover of the original object on which the transitioned section is zero.

source.place: Lemma 59.51.8, second proof; affine section reduction

proof.text: Use the locally bijective derived-Hom-to-homology comparison on the shifted source and target. Lift a section locally through the source comparison and refine using local injectivity at the target until its raw derived image is zero. The comparison is the canonical homology map evaluated at the identity generator; its naturality follows from naturality of the homology shift isomorphism.

Apply Scheme.exists_finite_affine_of_mem_smallEtaleTopology to the resulting covering sieve. Reindex the finite affine family by ULift (Fin n), and apply exists_cartesianHigherImage_finite_raw_classes_eq_zero to its finitely many raw representatives. This gives one later index and one arrow to the original index.

Naturality of the raw-sections comparison identifies each transitioned homology section with the comparison of the transitioned raw class, which is zero. Generate a covering sieve from the finite family and use naturality under further restrictions. Finally extract a finite affine refinement of that sieve to obtain the displayed conclusion. For finite-cover separatedness, compose the stage sheaf with the forgetful functor to types and apply IsSeparatedFor.ext to the covering sieve; no new preservation-of-injectives instance is declared.

proof_origin.place: Second proof, part (2); V1 repair registers the already existing finite-raw-class dependency and records the locally bijective comparison and sheaf-separatedness glue actually used.

theorem exists_cartesianHigherImage_affine_section_local_zero
    {k : Type u} [Field k]
    {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I] [IsCofiltered I]
    (D : I ⥤ Over (Spec (.of k)))
    [∀ i, QuasiCompact (D.obj i).hom] [∀ i, QuasiSeparated (D.obj i).hom]
    [∀ {i j : I} (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map a).left]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit ((Over.forget _).mapCone c))
    [QuasiCompact c.pt.hom] [QuasiSeparated c.pt.hom]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (q : ℕ) (U : c.pt.left.Etale) [IsAffine U.left] (i : I)
    (x : (cartesianHigherImageStage D c f F q i).obj.obj (Opposite.op U))
    (hx : (cartesianHigherImageLeg D c f F q i).hom.app (Opposite.op U) x = 0) :
    ∃ (j : I) (a : j ⟶ i) (J : Type u) (_ : Fintype J)
      (V : J → c.pt.left.Etale) (r : ∀ t, V t ⟶ U),
      Sieve.ofArrows V r ∈ c.pt.left.smallEtaleTopology U ∧
      ∀ t, (cartesianHigherImageTransition D c f F q a).hom.app
        (Opposite.op (V t))
        ((cartesianHigherImageStage D c f F q i).obj.map (r t).op x) = 0
